changelog: Fixed download speed telemetry on all completed cards, including yt-dlp fallback and progressive MP4 downloads
Added optional Download Speed Stats setting with copyable telemetry on completed download cards
Added separate 0–100% network download and 0–100% audio/video mux progress phases with phase-specific speed and ETA UI
Fixed foreground playback startup timeout and added persistent background media notification controls with live playback handoff
Added two-way background audio/video playback position handoff with per-media resume persistence and notification re-open support
Added bounded 8-worker parallel video/audio range downloads with exact byte totals, positional writes, native EMA speed and live ETA
Prevented incomplete in-app APK downloads from triggering installation; added byte-verified resume and APK archive validation
Widened brightness and volume gesture HUD pills so 100% displays without truncation
Fixed exact video and audio stream size totals and parallelized stream downloads with monotonic progress
Added bounded 5 MiB IPv4-preferred OkHttp stream downloads, 256 KiB NewPipe prebuffering, local-only FFmpeg remuxing, and integer byte-based progress
Restored single-finger player gestures after pinch zoom, locked seek UI during swipe scrubbing, and added Android system music volume slider with hardware-key sync
Fixed IPv4-preferred OkHttp DNS sorting to compile correctly while preserving IPv4-first connection attempts
Fixed canonical YouTube stream caching, added 15-minute cache TTL and Googlevideo prewarming, and replaced fractional pre-byte progress with clean integer percentages
Added translucent Sound/Brightness HUD backdrops and honest staged download progress with cached NewPipe streams
Fixed 1000x size estimates, show only available resolutions, and display actual downloaded video resolution
Added NewPipe itag-based 1080p selection, FFmpeg mux fallback and video-track validation; improved thumbnail, scrollbar, artwork and updater
Fixed PiP UI cast crash and improved player title marquee and progress styling
Persisted Library snapshots and deferred scans for instant tab display
Added intro-gated auto-open for successfully prefetched copied media URLs
Accelerated playlist thumbnails with system APIs and bounded parallel decoding
Improved video library header spacing and player controls
Fixed music seeking and smooth playback progress updates
Prevented clipboard auto-paste from opening download dialogs
Replaced flashing blue library thumbnail placeholders with dark placeholders
Added the JET Downloader cold-start intro animation
Added silent 24-hour yt-dlp engine auto-update checks
Restored video player gradient scrims and rounded full-width seek bar
Stopped background music playback when starting a video and improved audio focus handling
Made swipe-seek HUD transparent and softened the dark-mode URL input border
Added draggable fast scrolling to Library and Downloads
Preserved rotating track artwork during music playback
Restored high-contrast URL borders and transparent video overlays
Added asynchronous latest-file thumbnail hydration and stopped music when video playback starts
Kept player controls, progress bar, and gesture HUDs visible throughout active touch, swipe, and scrubbing interactions
